title: SEO and listing-quality monitoring on our listings (was a listing-capture v0 non-goal; requested by Warren 2026-10-07)
acceptance_criteria: The checks are the ones Warren names (decision): for example title, image count, description, key attributes, search position for named terms
Each check is read from the stored listing snapshot; a re-parse needs no re-fetch
A failing check is a finding on the listing with its evidence, not a score with hidden weights
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
